AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
